stem.text: A trolley of mass $600\,\text{kg}$ is initially at point P on a slope, at a height of $80\,\text{m}$ above ground level, as shown. The trolley is released from rest and moves along the slope, first coming to rest at point Q, at height $h$ above ground level.

stem.alt: Trolley at point P at the top of a curved slope that runs down to a low point and rises to point Q, with a vertical arrow of 80 m from P to ground level, a height h marked at Q, the distance 1.5 km marked along the slope, and the note NOT TO SCALE.

stem.text: The total distance PQ moved by the trolley along the slope is $1.5\,\text{km}$. A constant resistive force of $300\,\text{N}$ opposes the motion of the trolley on the slope.
